milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The stone brick stairs are at the dungeon entrance at approximately (6, 0, 4) in spawn-relative coords. The player must navigate near them and face toward them to confirm visual identification. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 model 'player can see the stairs'.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The iron bars wall is at z=8, centered around x=6. The player must navigate inside the structure and face the iron bars to confirm visual identification. Using max_distance=8 since the player needs to be inside the structure (not just seeing from outside) to meaningfully 'find' them as part of the dungeon progression.

Uses count_in_box_at_most(kind=mob, max_count=0) because this is a kill/combat task. The zombie is summoned at (6, 0, 10) inside the dungeon. A generous box (±15 in XZ, ±5 in Y) ensures the zombie stays within the detection area even if it pathfinds around before being killed. max_count=0 means no zombie remains alive in the area.

Uses inventory_has because mining gray terracotta with an iron pickaxe causes the block to drop into the player's inventory. The player is given an iron pickaxe in the scene, so the mined block will appear in inventory. min_count=1 confirms at least one block was successfully mined.
